feeds.title: Caroline in the City Blog
feeds.description: Caroline in the City is a blog about adventures in cities and travel tales around the world. Caroline in the City is a travel blog about life in the Southern States, posts include tales of elephant rides, foreign boys, hostel reviews, photographs, videos and the occasional piece of hard hitting journalism.

feeds.title: Atlanta Homes & Lifestyles
feeds.description: Published since 1983, Atlanta Homes & Lifestyles is the city's only monthly home and garden magazine. Dedicated to showcasing the best in design for the City, the publication also serves as a definitive guide to cultivating Atlanta style, offering unmatched entrée into the area's most inspiring residences. A longtime champion of the Atlanta design community, AH&L's coverage of local design professionals, premier shops and showrooms, decorative and fine arts, restaurants, and cultural events is second to none.

feeds.title: Life Family Fun
feeds.description: Life Family Fun is a resource for favorite family & luxury travel destinations, active lifestyle, parenting tips, family recipes, healthy recipes and technology favorites.

feeds.title: Southern Hospitality Blog
feeds.description: Rhoda is from Atlanta, GA and she loves decorating and DIY projects. She believes that decorating a home doesn't have to cost a fortune and has spent years thrifting at antique markets and yard sales, finding those treasures that make a home unique. She is here to inspire and encourage other women to find their own inner creativity.

feeds.title: Atlanta Parent Magazine
feeds.description: Since 1983, Atlanta Parents has been a source of family fun - where to go, what to do, and more, and covers important topics such as childcare, family life, education, motherhood, food, health and more. Atlanta Parent Magazine knows parenting. From the first days of caring for a newborn to the fun and unpredictable teenage years, it offers award-winning and practical information about important issues in the lives of Atlanta families.

feeds.title: Thou Swell
feeds.description: Welcome to Thou Swell, an Atlanta interior design & lifestyle blog curated by emerging designer Kevin Francis O'Gara, sharing original home decor projects, entertaining inspiration, decoration tips, travel guides, gardening, and a fresh spin on Southern style. Thou Swell has become a destination for interior lovers and entertaining enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Atlanta Magazine
feeds.description: Since 1961, Atlanta magazine has served as the authority on Atlanta, providing its monthly readers with a mix of long-form nonfiction, lively lifestyle coverage, in-depth service journalism, and literary essays, columns, and profiles. The city's only general-interest magazine, Atlanta Magazine is recognized regionally and nationally for journalism and design excellence.

feeds.title: The Savvy Mama Lifestyle
feeds.description: A resource for family travel tips, Millennial parenting, entertainment, recipes, & reviews. We love featuring fun travel destinations, great food and things to do as a family. A blog by Kimberly Stroh - a busy mom of three boys working as an Atlanta family lifestyle & travel blogger.

feeds.title: Blushing Black
feeds.description: Blushing Black stemmed from a simple idea: to create a beautiful, digital space where I could express my thoughts, showcase creativity and share everything in between. I share content & lifestyle topics that all women could relate to. It turned out to be a safe space where women could feel like were having girl-chat on the sofa or laughing over Sunday brunch.

feeds.title: Hey Simply
feeds.description: Simply Sabrina is a petite fashion and lifestyle blog based in Atlanta Georgia . Simply Sabrina shares personal style looks, beauty tricks, recipes and interior design.

feeds.title: Southern State of Mind Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers topics such as style, home decor, travel, DIY & crafts, holidays and parties, and many more. Heather is a lifestyle blogger that hopes to inspire her readers with her Atlanta Lifestyle and HomeStyle blog to enjoy Life in Southern style.

feeds.title: Danna Marie
feeds.description: Find blogs on home decor, recipies, beauty, travel, health and wellness, mini styles. Danna Thompson is a southern lifestyle blogger, mama and style seeker who shares about travels, family, fitness and fashion and more in Atlanta, Georgia .

feeds.title: Lavin Label
feeds.description: Monica Lavin from Lavin Label is a Top Southern Blogger and Southern Living Contributor,shares tips and inspiration ranging from all things home decor and entertaining to fashion and travel.

feeds.title: Love Peace and Tiny Feet
feeds.description: Ari Adams, Atlanta Green Lifestyle Mom Blogger and CEO of ShiftCon shares tips on parenting, Chiropractic, eco-friendly and green living, holistic health, family entertainment, Disney activity sheets & family travel.

feeds.title: Wander North Georgia Blog
feeds.description: The weekend guide to Cartersville Georgia. A blog focused on the North Georgia mountains and communities, food & drink, shopping, sleep, small business, weekend guides that call them home with a store in beautiful downtown Clayton, Georgia.

feeds.title: Darling Down South
feeds.description: Blogs cover posts on food, style, and travel. Darling Down South is a lifestyle blog that encompasses what it means to be a Modern Southerner giving an experience for readers on how to live the fascinating Southern Lifestyle.
